title: Red Line: heavy rain, wet rail, slippery tracks
content: ALERT (active during heavy rain, downpour, or thunderstorm): Red Line trains are running with 5-8 minute residual delays system-wide because of slippery rail conditions, wet rail, and cautious operating speeds. Keywords: raining, rain, heavy rain, downpour, thunderstorm, wet rail, slippery tracks, puddles, storm, soaked, drizzle. Trains continue to operate. Riders should plan an extra 10 minutes of buffer.

alternatives: Allow extra buffer; service still running

title: UMass Boston shuttle: high-wind suspension
content: ALERT (active during high-wind warnings, gusts above 50 mph, gales, or windstorms): The UMass Boston JFK <-> Campus Center shuttle is temporarily suspended for safety. Keywords: wind, windy, high wind, gust, gale, windstorm, blowing, gusty, advisory. Riders should walk between JFK/UMass and Campus Center (about 25 minutes on foot) or wait for service to resume. Plan a 30-minute extra buffer.

title: Blue Line: extreme cold, freezing, signal issues
content: ALERT (active during extreme cold, deep freeze, or subzero overnight lows): Blue Line trains are experiencing 8-12 minute delays due to switch and signal problems caused by ice on tracks and frozen mechanisms. Keywords: cold, freezing, extreme cold, subzero, deep freeze, ice on tracks, frostbite, frigid, arctic. Service continues. Consider alternative routes between downtown and East Boston where possible.

alternatives: Bus 116/117 between Maverick and Wonderland area

title: MBTA: heatwave, hot weather, HVAC and slower service
content: ALERT (active during heatwaves, hot weather above 95F, or extreme humidity): Several rapid-transit cars have HVAC failures and overhead-rail expansion forces operators to run at reduced speed. Keywords: heat, heatwave, hot, hot weather, high temperature, humidity, AC failure, sweltering, scorching, warm. Add 5-7 minutes to typical end-to-end times across all rapid transit lines.

title: Holiday service: MBTA Sunday schedule + UMB shuttle off
content: ALERT (active on federal or UMass holidays such as MLK Day, Memorial Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Year, or campus closure days): MBTA operates on a Sunday schedule with longer headways (Red/Orange/Blue every 12-15 minutes). UMass Boston shuttle does NOT operate on holidays - riders must walk from JFK/UMass to Campus Center (about 25 minutes) or take bus 8 to Kenmore as a workaround. Keywords: holiday, holiday service, holiday Monday, MLK day, federal holiday.

title: Red Line late-night reduced frequency
content: ALERT (active 23:00-01:00 weekdays, 22:00-midnight Sundays): Red Line headway increases to every 20-30 minutes after 11 PM. The last train leaves Alewife around 12:45 AM weekdays. Keywords: late night, last train, after 11pm.

title: UMass Boston shuttle: weekend reduced
content: ALERT (active Saturday, Sunday, and academic-break weekdays): The JFK/UMass <-> Campus Center shuttle runs every 15-20 minutes from 09:00 to 20:00 (instead of every 5-10 minutes weekday daytime). Keywords: saturday, sunday, weekend, academic break, spring break, winter break. Plan an extra 10 minutes for shuttle wait.

title: Travel time: Downtown Crossing -> JFK/UMass
content: Downtown Crossing to JFK/UMass on the Red Line takes about 8 minutes off-peak (std 2 min). At peak, about 11 minutes (std 3 min).

title: Travel time: Park Street -> JFK/UMass
content: Park Street to JFK/UMass on the Red Line takes about 9 minutes off-peak (std 2 min). At peak, about 11 minutes (std 3 min).

title: Travel time: BU East -> JFK/UMass
content: BU East to JFK/UMass via Green Line B to Park Street, transfer to Red Line southbound to JFK/UMass takes about 25 minutes off-peak (std 5 min). At peak, about 30 minutes (std 7 min) due to Green Line surface delays.
